# vendor

- `commonware-storage/`: commonware-storage 2026.9.0 exactly as published on crates.io (`commonware-storage-2026.9.0.crate`, sha256 `15ec50ba1efad76170c65d8c53baefc49da20eed02df9eedb3aa0754f2ff1d53`, the checksum `Cargo.lock` pinned), built in its place through `[patch.crates-io]` in the root `Cargo.toml`. Patched on top of it, in its own commit: an owned reader of an Any QMDB's operation log (`qmdb::any::db::Db::reader`, `journal::authenticated::Reader`, `merkle::full::Reader`, `journal::contiguous::Snapshottable`, and `qmdb::sync::Source` for the reader), so the node serves `/v1/sync` from what its block writer publishes. The copy and its `[patch.crates-io]` line go at the first commonware release that carries an equivalent reader; no upstream PR is filed.
